articles.title_en: Temporary work contracts and female labor market outcomes
articles.title_cn: 临时工作合同与女性劳动力市场结果
articles.abstract_en: How does initial placement in a temporary work contract affect workers’ subsequent labor market outcomes? We study a unique set of natural experiments: In the mid-1990s, the Japanese airline industry implemented a new hiring policy using temporary employment contracts. The policy was later reversed in the mid-2010s. Examining the universe of employment records from one of Japan’s major airlines as well as government surveys to compare outcomes for cohorts of flight attendants hired just before to those hired just after these changes in industry policy, we find that workers starting on temporary contracts were less likely to remain with the firm over time and are less likely to have children within 10 years after starting the job. These findings do not appear to be the result of selection on observables.
articles.abstract_cn: 初始被安排到临时工作合同如何影响工人随后的劳动力市场结果？我们研究了一组独特的自然实验：在1990年代中期，日本航空业实施了一项使用临时雇佣合同的新招聘政策。该政策后来在2010年代中期被逆转。通过考察日本一家主要航空公司的全部就业记录以及政府调查，比较在行业政策变化前后不久被雇佣的空乘人员群体的结果，我们发现，以临时合同开始工作的工人随着时间的推移更不可能留在公司，并且在开始工作后10年内生育孩子的可能性更低。这些发现似乎并非由可观测特征的选择效应所致。

articles.title_en: Too much commitment? An online experiment with tempting YouTube content
articles.title_cn: 过度承诺？关于诱人YouTube内容的在线实验
articles.abstract_en: We explore the possibility that demand for costly commitment may prove unnecessary and thus excessive. In an online experiment, subjects face a tedious productivity task where tempting YouTube videos invite procrastination. Subjects can pay for a commitment device that removes the videos with probability less than one, allowing us to compare their willingness to pay with realized material and psychological costs of temptation. A significant share of subjects do overestimate their commitment demand, being overly pessimistic about their performance when tempted. Even more subjects underestimate demand, and total realized losses from revealed undercommitment is greater than from overcommitment. Thus, undercommitment dominates and is inconsistent with pure noise in stated demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了这样一种可能性：对昂贵承诺的需求可能被证明是不必要的，因而过度。在一项在线实验中，受试者面临一项乏味的生产力任务，其中诱人的YouTube视频会引发拖延。受试者可以付费购买一种承诺装置，该装置以小于一的概率移除视频，使我们能够比较他们的支付意愿与诱惑带来的实际物质和心理成本。相当大比例的受试者确实高估了他们的承诺需求，对受诱惑时的表现过于悲观。更多的受试者低估了需求，且揭示出的承诺不足造成的总实际损失大于过度承诺造成的损失。因此，承诺不足占主导地位，并且与陈述需求中的纯粹噪声不一致。

articles.title_en: Do market societies undermine civic morality? An empirical investigation into market societies and civic morality across the globe
articles.title_cn: 市场社会会削弱公民道德吗？一项关于市场社会与公民道德的全球实证研究
articles.abstract_en: Although the market is often praised as a wealth-creating coordination system, it is also repeatedly criticized for undermining morality. We empirically examine whether exposure to markets is associated with lower levels of civic morality, i.e. the responsibility and respect of the individual towards society's rules and the public good. Because most prior research lacks generalizability, we scrutinize the relationship between markets and individuals’ civic morality in a large set of highly culturally and institutionally diverse countries and regions. Multilevel analyses of cross-country individual-level survey data indicate a robust positive relationship between market exposure and civic morality. We find that subnational regions and countries experiencing an increase in market activity also experience an increase in individuals’ civic morality. Our results suggest that the mechanism behind this relation works through the fairness of the market process. We conclude that there is no empirical evidence suggesting that markets undermine civic morality.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管市场常被赞誉为创造财富的协调系统，但也屡遭批评，认为其削弱了道德。我们实证考察了市场接触是否与较低的公民道德水平相关，即个人对社会规则和公共物品的责任与尊重。由于先前多数研究缺乏普遍性，我们在大量文化和制度高度多样化的国家和地区中，审视了市场与个人公民道德之间的关系。对跨国个体层面调查数据的多层分析表明，市场接触与公民道德之间存在稳健的正相关关系。我们发现，次国家区域和国家市场活动的增加，也伴随着个体公民道德的提高。我们的结果表明，这一关系背后的机制是通过市场过程的公平性起作用的。我们得出结论，没有经验证据表明市场会削弱公民道德。

articles.title_en: Unawareness and risk taking: The role of context
articles.title_cn: 无知与风险承担：情境的作用
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of exposure to unawareness on risk preferences using a novel experimental task. The task has solutions that are difficult to find, but easy to verify and so exposes subjects to unawareness in a natural way. We find that increased exposure to unawareness alone does not affect risk taking. The role of context, however, is shown to be important. For treatments inducing higher unawareness, subjects are more risk averse when the risk elicitation task is framed in the same context as the unawareness-inducing task versus framed in a neutral way; we observe no such differences for the control treatment. We propose a novel decision theoretic model that guides the interpretation of the experimental findings. Our results could inform the decision and game-theoretic literatures, as most models of unawareness assume risk preferences are orthogonal to varying awareness.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项新颖的实验任务研究暴露于无知对风险偏好的影响。该任务有难以找到但易于验证的解决方案，从而以自然的方式使受试者暴露于无知。我们发现，仅增加无知暴露并不影响风险承担。然而，情境的作用被证明是重要的。对于诱导更高无知程度的处理组，当风险诱导任务在与无知诱导任务相同的情境下呈现时，受试者比在中性情境下呈现时更加风险厌恶；我们在对照组中未观察到此类差异。我们提出了一个新颖的决策理论模型，以指导对实验结果的解释。我们的结果可为决策和博弈论文献提供信息，因为大多数无知模型假设风险偏好与意识变化正交。

articles.title_en: Cash payments and the penny policy debate
articles.title_cn: 现金支付与便士政策辩论
articles.abstract_en: This article quantifies the burden of exchanging currency notes and coins using a model of optimal consumer-merchant exchange of cash payments and consumer payment choice diary data. The model is then applied to analyze a policy debate whether to eliminate the penny coin from circulation. We find that penny elimination would reduce the burden of exchanging cash and will not have any significant inflationary consequences caused by price rounding. Surprisingly, a removal of both the penny and nickel coins from circulation would slightly increase (not decrease) the burden relative to penny elimination only.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过一个最优消费者-商家现金支付交换模型和消费者支付选择日记数据，量化了兑换纸币和硬币的负担。该模型随后被应用于分析是否应从流通中取消便士硬币的政策辩论。我们发现，取消便士将减少现金兑换的负担，并且不会因价格四舍五入而产生任何显著的通胀后果。令人惊讶的是，同时取消便士和镍币将相对于仅取消便士略微增加（而非减少）负担。

articles.title_en: Where have all the children gone? An empirical study of child abandonment and abduction in China
articles.title_cn: 孩子们都去哪儿了？中国儿童遗弃与拐卖的实证研究
articles.abstract_en: In the past 40 years, a large number of children have been abandoned or abducted in China. We argue that the implementation of the one-child policy can help to explain changes in the patterns of both child abandonment and child abduction. We also contend that the cultural preference for sons in China has shaped unique gender-based patterns, as attested to by the fact that the majority of the children who are abandoned are girls and the majority of the children who are abducted are boys. We provide empirical evidence for the following findings: (1) Stricter implementation of the one-child policy leads to more child abandonment locally and more child abduction in neighboring regions; (2) A stronger son-preference bias intensifies both the local effects and spatial spillover effects of the region's one-child policy on child abandonment and abduction; and, (3) With the gradual relaxation of the one-child policy after 2002, the frequency of both child abandonment and child abduction has decreased significantly. This paper is the first to provide empirical evidence regarding the unintended consequences of the one-child policy in relation to missing children in China.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去40年中，中国有大量儿童被遗弃或被拐卖。我们认为，计划生育政策的实施有助于解释儿童遗弃和拐卖模式的变化。我们还认为，中国重男轻女的文化偏好塑造了基于性别的独特模式，这从被遗弃儿童中大多数为女孩、被拐卖儿童中大多数为男孩的事实可以得到证实。我们提供了以下发现的实证证据：（1）计划生育政策执行越严格，本地儿童遗弃现象越多，邻近地区儿童拐卖现象也越多；（2）更强的男孩偏好加剧了该地区计划生育政策对儿童遗弃和拐卖的本地效应和空间溢出效应；（3）随着2002年后计划生育政策的逐步放宽，儿童遗弃和拐卖的发生频率均显著下降。本文首次提供了关于计划生育政策与中国失踪儿童问题相关的意外后果的实证证据。

articles.title_en: Long-term impact of exposure to violent conflict: Are there gender differences?
articles.title_cn: 暴力冲突暴露的长期影响：是否存在性别差异？
articles.abstract_en: We examine gender differences in the long-term impact of childhood exposure to violent conflict on a range of behavioral traits by conducting a large-scale field experiment in the Indian state of Assam, which witnessed fatal ethnic riots in the early 1980s. We exploit an individual's geographic location and age at exposure to riots to examine the effects of varied exposure to violent conflict during childhood and early adolescence on their pro- and antisocial behavior, as well as their risk and time preferences. The results suggest that, as the intensity of exposure to riots during childhood increases, females show more prosocial behavior, whereas males demonstrate a higher degree of antisocial behavior. Our study offers important insights into the divergent effects of conflict by gender.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过在印度阿萨姆邦进行的大规模实地实验，考察了童年时期暴露于暴力冲突对一系列行为特质的长期影响的性别差异。阿萨姆邦在1980年代初期发生了致命的种族骚乱。我们利用个体在骚乱暴露时的地理位置和年龄，来考察童年和青春期早期不同程度地暴露于暴力冲突对其亲社会行为、反社会行为以及风险和时间偏好的影响。结果表明，随着童年时期骚乱暴露强度的增加，女性表现出更多的亲社会行为，而男性则表现出更高程度的反社会行为。我们的研究为冲突对性别产生的不同影响提供了重要见解。

articles.title_en: The effects of emergency government cash transfers on beliefs and behaviours during the COVID pandemic: Evidence from Brazil
articles.title_cn: 紧急政府现金转移对COVID疫情期间信念和行为的影响：来自巴西的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impacts of emergency cash-transfers on individuals’ social distancing behaviour and beliefs about COVID-19. We focus on the impacts of “Auxilio Emergencial” (AE): a large-scale cash-transfer in Brazil targeting low-income individuals who were unemployed or informally employed during the pandemic. To identify causal effects we exploit exogenous variation, arising from the AE design, in individuals’ access to the cash-transfer programme. Using data from an online survey, our results suggest that eligibility to the emergency cash transfer led to a reduced likelihood of individuals contracting COVID-19, likely to have been driven by a reduction in working hours. Moreover, the cash transfer seems to have increased perceptions about the seriousness of coronavirus, while also exacerbating misconceptions about the pandemic. These findings indicate effects of emergency cash-transfers in determining individuals’ narratives about a pandemic, in enabling social distancing and potentially in reducing the spread of the disease.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了紧急现金转移对个人社交距离行为和关于COVID-19信念的影响。我们关注“紧急援助”（AE）的影响：这是巴西一项针对疫情期间失业或非正规就业的低收入人群的大规模现金转移计划。为识别因果效应，我们利用AE设计中产生的个人获得现金转移计划机会的外生变异。使用在线调查数据，我们的结果表明，有资格获得紧急现金转移降低了个体感染COVID-19的可能性，这可能是由于工作时间的减少所致。此外，现金转移似乎增强了对冠状病毒严重性的认知，同时也加剧了对大流行的误解。这些发现表明，紧急现金转移在决定个人对大流行的叙述、促进社交距离以及可能减少疾病传播方面具有影响。

articles.title_en: Reputation and information aggregation
articles.abstract_en: We analyze how reputation concerns of a partially informed decision maker affect her ability to extract information from reputation-concerned advisors. Too-high decision maker’s reputation concerns destroy her incentives to seek advice. However, when such concerns are low, she is tempted to solicit advice regardless of her private information, which can undermine advisors’ truth-telling incentives. The optimal strength of the decision maker’s reputation concerns maximizes advice-seeking while preserving advisors’ truth-telling. Prior uncertainty about the state of nature calls for a more reputation-concerned decision maker. Higher expected competence of advisors may worsen information aggregation, unless the decision maker’s reputation concerns are properly adjusted.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了部分知情决策者的声誉关切如何影响她从有声誉关切的顾问那里提取信息的能力。过高的决策者声誉关切会破坏她寻求建议的激励。然而，当这种关切较低时，她倾向于不顾自己的私人信息而征求建议，这可能削弱顾问说真话的激励。决策者声誉关切的最优强度在保持顾问说真话的同时最大化寻求建议的行为。关于自然状态的先验不确定性要求决策者更加关注声誉。顾问预期能力的提高可能会恶化信息聚合，除非决策者的声誉关切得到适当调整。

articles.title_en: Anti-sweatshop activism and the safety-employment tradeoff: Evidence from Bangladesh's Rana Plaza disaster
articles.title_cn: 反血汗工厂行动与安全-就业权衡：来自孟加拉国拉纳广场灾难的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of anti-sweatshop activism on garment industry employment and the number of firms in Bangladesh following the 2013 Rana Plaza factory disaster. The disaster led to activism that created two major brand-enforced factory fire and safety agreements. We employ a synthetic control methodology to investigate the tradeoffs associated with the reaction to the disaster and find that it led to 33.3 percent fewer garment factories in Bangladesh by 2016 and 28.3 percent fewer people employed in Bangladesh's garment industry by 2017. Given the importance of the garment industry in Bangladesh's development in providing a pathway out of extreme property, our finding raises important questions about the efficacy of anti-sweatshop activism.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了2013年孟加拉国拉纳广场工厂灾难后，反血汗工厂行动对服装业就业和企业数量的影响。该灾难引发了行动，促成了两项由品牌主导的工厂消防和安全协议。我们采用合成控制方法来研究应对灾难所伴随的权衡，发现到2016年，孟加拉国的服装工厂减少了33.3%，到2017年，孟加拉国服装业的就业人数减少了28.3%。鉴于服装业在孟加拉国发展中提供摆脱极端贫困途径的重要性，我们的发现对反血汗工厂行动的有效性提出了重要问题。

articles.title_en: The 30 Years' War and Violent Crime in the Late 19th Century
articles.title_cn: 30世纪末的19年战争和暴力犯罪
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a unique data set of estimated population losses in Germany as a result of the 30 Years’ War (30 YW), fought between 1618 and 1648, which we match to German counties as defined in 1900. We find that counties with larger population losses experience significantly more youth assault crimes in 1900. To support a more causal interpretation of our results, we identify a set of counterfactual counties via propensity score matching. On this matched sample, we find that a county’s 30 YW population losses are largely unrelated to a wide range of pre-30 YW social, economic, geographic and religious characteristics, indicating that our result is driven by differential exposure to the violence of the war and not by pre-existing county differences. Although, owing to the historical nature of our data, it is difficult to uncover precise mechanisms, we present additional evidence that suggests 30 YW population losses lead to a general deterioration of county social and economic conditions over time: Differential exposure to the violence of the war led otherwise similar counties to experience more conflict following the 30 YW as well as higher rates of child mortality, less welfare expenditure, and increases in suicides some 250 years later. (JEL: N33, N43, D74, Z10)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了1618和1648之间的30年战争（30 YW）造成的德国估计人口损失的独特数据集，我们将其与1900中定义的德国县进行匹配。我们发现人口流失较多的县在1900中经历了更多的青少年袭击犯罪。为了支持对我们的结果进行更因果的解释，我们通过倾向得分匹配确定了一组反事实县。在这个匹配的样本中，我们发现一个县的 30 YW 人口损失在很大程度上与 30 YW 之前的广泛社会、经济、地理和宗教特征无关，这表明我们的结果是由战争暴力的不同暴露程度驱动的，而不是由先前存在的县差异驱动的。尽管由于我们数据的历史性质，很难揭示精确的机制，但我们提供了额外的证据，表明30 YW人口损失导致县社会和经济状况随着时间的推移普遍恶化：不同程度地遭受战争暴力导致其他类似的县在30 YW之后经历更多冲突，以及更高的儿童死亡率、更少的福利支出和一些250年后自杀率的增加。 （JEL：N33、N43、D74、Z10）

articles.title_en: R&D network formation with myopic and farsighted firms
articles.title_cn: 短视与远见企业的研发网络形成
articles.abstract_en: We study the formation of R&D networks when firms can be either myopic or farsighted. Stability leads to R&D networks consisting of either asymmetric components or nearly symmetric components. Farsighted firms have in average more collaborations but myopic firms can be central for spreading the innovation. We introduce yes-firms that form links subject to the constraint of non-negative profits. Yes-firms stabilize R&D networks that maximize social welfare. Finally, the evolution of R&D networks shows that nearly symmetric R&D networks will be rapidly dismantled, socially optimal R&D networks will persist many periods, while asymmetric R&D networks will persist forever.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当企业可以是短视或远见时研发网络的形成。稳定性导致研发网络由非对称组件或近似对称组件组成。远见企业平均拥有更多合作，但短视企业可能在传播创新方面处于核心地位。我们引入了在非负利润约束下形成链接的“是”企业。“是”企业稳定了最大化社会福利的研发网络。最后，研发网络的演化表明，近似对称的研发网络将被迅速拆除，社会最优的研发网络将持续多个时期，而非对称的研发网络将永远持续。

articles.title_en: Cooperation in indefinite games: Evidence from red queen games
articles.abstract_en: We test whether the length of an indefinite horizon, or that the horizon is indefinite as opposed to finite, affects cooperation in repeated 3×3Red Queen Games. With our participant population, and our experimental program and procedures, the length of the indefinite horizon significantly affects cooperation in the Prisoner’s Dilemma. It also significantly affects cooperation in the Red Queen Game, but only after participants are experienced. The indefiniteness of the horizon does not significantly affect cooperation in either game. Our results highlight the importance of experience for cooperation in indefinite games with even slightly larger strategy spaces than the Prisoner’s Dilemma.

articles.title_en: Can barely winning lead to losing? Gender and past performance
articles.title_cn: 勉强获胜会导致失败吗？性别与过往表现
articles.abstract_en: We use high-volume data from professional tennis to estimate the causal effect of past on current performance for women and men. To identify this effect, we exploit double faults as exogenous shocks to past performance. We estimate that men do not react to near setbacks in the past. In contrast, women perform considerably worse after near setbacks. Heterogeneity analysis reveals different effects depending on experience, ability, and the intermediate score. Our results are robust to a number of sensitivity checks. A potential explanation for our findings are gender differences in negative psychological momentum.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用职业网球的高容量数据来估计过去表现对女性和男性当前表现的因果效应。为了识别这一效应，我们利用双误作为过去表现的外生冲击。我们估计男性对过去的近似挫折没有反应。相比之下，女性在近似挫折后表现明显更差。异质性分析揭示了不同效应取决于经验、能力和中间比分。我们的结果对多项敏感性检验是稳健的。对我们发现的一个潜在解释是负面心理动量的性别差异。

articles.title_en: On the Interpretation of Giving in Dictator Games When the Recipient is a Charity
articles.title_cn: 当接受者为慈善机构时独裁者博弈中给予行为的解释
articles.abstract_en: In experimental dictator games, subjects typically give substantial portions of their endowment to their partner, which has been interpreted as evidence that individuals are altruistic. Two influential studies find that when the choice set is expanded to allow subjects to take money away from an anonymous partner, they no longer give money. This suggests that when partners are anonymous, the seemingly altruistic behavior observed in standard dictator games is an artifact of the limited choice set. A vast literature employs dictator games in a different important context where the recipient is not anonymous: charitable giving. In this study, we examine whether generosity vanishes upon allowing subjects to take money when dictators are partnered with a charity instead of an anonymous partner. While we replicate the result that subjects are substantially less generous when the option to take money away from an anonymous partner is added to their choice set, we find that subjects remain generous when the take options are added when the partner is a charity. Regardless of whether subjects are able to take money from the charity or not, subjects give positive amounts just as often, the mean and median donation amounts are similar, and the modal choice is to give the entire endowment to the charity. These results suggest that dictator games remain a useful tool in studies of charitable giving.
articles.abstract_cn: 在实验性独裁者博弈中，被试通常会将相当大一部分禀赋给予其搭档，这被解释为个体具有利他主义的证据。两项有影响力的研究发现，当选择集扩展至允许被试从匿名搭档处取走金钱时，他们不再给予金钱。这表明，当搭档匿名时，标准独裁者博弈中观察到的看似利他的行为是有限选择集的人为产物。大量文献在另一个重要情境中使用独裁者博弈，其中接受者并非匿名：慈善捐赠。在本研究中，我们考察当独裁者与慈善机构而非匿名搭档配对时，允许被试取走金钱是否会使慷慨行为消失。虽然我们复制了当选择集中加入从匿名搭档处取走金钱的选项时被试显著不那么慷慨的结果，但我们发现当搭档是慈善机构时，加入取走选项后被试仍然慷慨。无论被试是否能够从慈善机构取走金钱，被试给予正数额的频率相同，平均和中位数捐赠金额相似，且众数选择是将全部禀赋给予慈善机构。这些结果表明，独裁者博弈在慈善捐赠研究中仍然是一个有用的工具。

articles.title_en: Financial transfers from parents to adult children
articles.title_cn: 父母向成年子女的财务转移
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses 1996–2014 longitudinal HRS data to establish the relative importance of intervivos transfers, bequests and coresidency in the United States. We find that when computing the relative importance of intervivos transfers versus bequests, the aggregate perspective that pools all data into a single cross-section is very different than the parent-level longitudinal perspective, highlighting the special value of panel data. This difference reflects the fact that large bequests are highly concentrated and play an influential role at the aggregate level, while at the micro parent-level, intervivos transfers constitute the main form of financial support for most parents. Regarding coresidency, we find that although older children and parents tend to coreside when the child is helping the parent, coresidency tends to be more prevalent among poorer, younger parents and their children. Children who ever coreside with parents also receive larger total intervivos transfers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用1996-2014年纵向HRS数据，确立了美国生前转移、遗产和同住的相关重要性。我们发现，在计算生前转移与遗产的相对重要性时，将所有数据汇集成单一横截面的总体视角与父母层面的纵向视角大不相同，这凸显了面板数据的特殊价值。这一差异反映了巨额遗产高度集中，在总体层面发挥重要影响，而在微观父母层面，生前转移构成了大多数父母财务支持的主要形式。关于同住，我们发现，尽管当子女帮助父母时，年长子女和父母倾向于同住，但同住在较贫穷、较年轻的父母及其子女中更为普遍。曾与父母同住的子女也获得更大总额的生前转移。

articles.title_en: When opportunities backfire: Alternatives reduce perseverance and success in task completion
articles.title_cn: 当机会适得其反：替代方案降低任务完成的坚持与成功
articles.abstract_en: We consider an agent who needs to finish one task under a time constraint. Would she benefit from having several alternatives of which she only needs to complete one, or is it better not to have options? We conjecture that agents will be worse off when having several options. In our experiment, the control group receives a single task to work on, while the treated group has two optional tasks to choose from. We find that having two alternatives negatively affects performance. Even when the additional task is substantially easier than the original one, having more options does not help. We discuss potential mechanisms and present evidence showing that many managers do not anticipate the negative effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个需要在时间限制内完成一项任务的代理人。如果她有多个只需完成其中一项的替代方案，她会受益，还是最好没有选择？我们推测，当有多个选择时，代理人会变得更糟。在我们的实验中，对照组收到单一任务，而处理组有两个可选任务。我们发现，拥有两个替代方案会对绩效产生负面影响。即使额外任务比原任务容易得多，拥有更多选择也无济于事。我们讨论了潜在机制，并提供了证据表明许多管理者并未预见到这些负面影响。

articles.title_en: Risking the future? Measuring risk attitudes towards delayed consequences
articles.title_cn: 冒险未来？衡量对延迟后果的风险态度
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents an experiment that investigates differences in risk attitudes in decisions with immediate versus delayed consequences. Our experimental design allows to control for the effects of discounting and timing of risk resolution. We show that individuals are more risk tolerant in situations involving delayed consequences. Investigations based on rank-dependent utility show that this finding is mainly driven by probability weighting. More precisely, probability weighting is more elevated for delayed consequences. This suggests an overall increase in decision-makers’ optimism regarding the chances of success when consequences materialize in the future.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过实验研究了即时后果与延迟后果决策中风险态度的差异。我们的实验设计能够控制贴现和风险解决时间的影响。我们表明，在涉及延迟后果的情况下，个体更加风险容忍。基于等级依赖效用的研究表明，这一发现主要由概率加权驱动。更确切地说，对于延迟后果，概率加权更为显著。这表明当后果在未来实现时，决策者对成功机会的整体乐观情绪有所增加。

articles.title_en: Automation and population growth: Theory and cross-country evidence
articles.title_cn: 自动化与人口增长：理论与跨国证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyse the relationship between declining population growth and automation. Theoretical considerations imply that countries with lower population growth introduce automation technologies faster. We test the theoretical implication on panel data for 60 countries over the time span 1993–2013. Regression estimates support the theoretical implication, suggesting that a 1% increase in population growth is associated with an approximately 2% reduction in the growth rate of robot density. Our results are robust to the inclusion of standard control variables, different estimation methods, dynamic specifications, and changes with respect to the measurement of the stock of robots.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了人口增长下降与自动化之间的关系。理论考量表明，人口增长率较低的国家引入自动化技术的速度更快。我们在1993-2013年间对60个国家的面板数据检验了这一理论含义。回归估计支持该理论含义，表明人口增长每增加1%，机器人密度的增长率大约降低2%。我们的结果在加入标准控制变量、采用不同估计方法、动态设定以及改变机器人存量衡量方式后依然稳健。

articles.title_en: Reputational effects on third-party agents: A study of the market for fine and rare wines
articles.title_cn: 第三方代理人的声誉效应：精品与稀有葡萄酒市场研究
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effectiveness of a quality assurance mechanism that relies on a third-party's reputation. We focus on the market for fine and rare wines where auction houses intermediating between sellers and buyers have also claimed expertise to assess product authenticity. An auction house's reputation can sustain product quality in this market only if consumers absorb relevant information and reduce demand through houses who fail at screening out counterfeits. We test the existence of such reputational effects by studying the market responses to a major disclosure from 2012 of three auction houses having auctioned thousands of bottles of fake wine. We find that these houses did suffer reputational losses. These losses are demonstrated over the following year by a decrease in equilibrium sales prices of all wines, and a decrease in sales quantities of older wines, relative to other houses.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了一种依赖第三方声誉的质量保证机制的有效性。我们聚焦于精品与稀有葡萄酒市场，在该市场中，介于买卖双方之间的拍卖行也声称具备评估产品真伪的专业知识。只有当消费者吸收相关信息并减少对未能筛选出赝品的拍卖行的需求时，拍卖行的声誉才能维持该市场的产品质量。我们通过研究市场对2012年三家拍卖行拍卖了数千瓶假酒这一重大披露的反应，来检验此类声誉效应的存在。我们发现这些拍卖行确实遭受了声誉损失。这些损失在接下来的一年中体现为，相对于其他拍卖行，所有葡萄酒的均衡销售价格下降，以及老年份葡萄酒的销售数量减少。
